title: Understanding MSE in Regularized Models
text: When comparing the training MSE of two models, consider how regularization affects the model's complexity and fit to the training data.

title: Effect of Regularization Parameter
text: The regularization parameter, lambda, influences the penalty applied to the model's coefficients. A higher lambda typically results in a simpler model with potentially higher bias but lower variance.

title: Comparing $$MSE_A$$ and $$MSE_B$$
text: Consider how the regularization parameter affects the training MSE for both models. Does the regularization always lead to a higher MSE for one model compared to the other?

title: Analyzing the Impact of Regularization
text: Given that both models use the same regularization parameter, $$lambda=2$$, and assuming the design matrix is not mean-centered, analyze the impact on $$MSE_A$$ and $$MSE_B$$.
